description: Corpay, Inc. is a global corporate payments company that helps businesses and consumers better manage and pay their expenses in a simple, controlled manner, providing a broad suite of payment and spend management solutions including accounts payable automation and cross-border payment solutions such as foreign exchange spot, forward and option transactions, commercial card programs, vehicle payment solutions such as fuel cards and toll payments, and lodging payment solutions. Since its incorporation in 2000 it has delivered payment and spend solutions with customized controls and robust capabilities that offer its customers a better way to pay, saving them time and ultimately letting them spend less, and it has been a member of the S&P 500 since 2018 and trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CPAY.
